paper.title: Gapless Nature of Spin Liquid in the $S=1/2$ Kagome Heisenberg Antiferromagnet with Neural-Network Quantum States
paper.authors: Andreas Raikos, Alessandro Sinibaldi, Riccardo Rende, Giuseppe Carleo, Federico Becca, Luciano Loris Viteritti

issues: Only Table 1 even-parity ground-state rows are included. Table 2 odd-parity excited states, variance/size extrapolations, literature comparisons, and values only plotted are excluded. L=12,14,16 require curator benchmark definitions; no registered size is substituted.

results.system_description: Spin-1/2 nearest-neighbor kagome Heisenberg H = J sum_<ij> S_i dot S_j, S = sigma/2, J = 1, no offset; 12 x 12 three-site cells (432 spins), rhombic periodic torus along both triangular Bravais vectors, each undirected bond once; total Sz = 0, momentum Gamma, even spin-inversion parity. C6v A1 projection.
results.variant: 8 layers, 12 heads, d=72; real output, Gamma, P=+1; C6v A1, 300 restoration steps
results.source_location: End Matter Table 1, L=12 row (HTML Sx1.T1); End Matter energy-estimation paragraph; Supplemental Material optimization and symmetry restoration
results.eligibility_evidence: Original final fixed-state variational energy of the explicitly represented ViT. The End Matter distinguishes final values from optimization curves and evaluates approximately 10^6 Monte Carlo samples per state with blurred sampling for unbiased variance. Time reversal and spatial/spin symmetry projections define the evaluated NQS; these are not projection Monte Carlo energies.
results.notes: Printed variance per site 0.00411(2); its central value is recorded. Parenthesized energy uncertainty is printed, but its precise statistical definition is not stated, hence unspecified. Closed-form classical q=0 phase prior (phi=0,+/-2pi/3 by sublattice), not an ED sign. Sz=0 is explicitly enforced by sampling. Source code train_kagome.py at tachys-dev/kagome_vit commit 9be57ce9c34fee73d0c88f0792556eb31241bf3a, SHA256 a8030ba1c8c7fcea2a50481fa64e962daa3ccf619711b5c2fc7e1517aef1261d, confirms the three-site primitive cell and six undirected bonds per cell. Its basis equals the registered basis up to inversion and translation. Architecture/sampling evidence is from this paper, not another paper.
